head.title: Corporate Event Catering Ideas Dubai | myCHEF Journal
head.meta_description: Corporate event catering ideas Dubai: match the day to drop-off, canapés, buffet or a seated dinner, with advertised floors and the page that owns each job.

opening_paragraph: Corporate event catering ideas in Dubai start with the job of the day, not a mood board. A working lunch is not a gala. A canapé reception is not a board dinner. Drop-off food starts from AED 90 per person. A staffed buffet starts from AED 120. Canapés and live stations start from AED 150. A chef cooking at the table is AED 700 to 950 per person. Book on the service page that matches the day. This article is the idea list.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: What makes corporate event catering ideas in Dubai work?
replace_in_block.new_heading: What makes corporate event catering ideas in Dubai work?
new_paragraphs: Name the job before you name the food. Feed people between meetings, get them talking, or mark an occasion. Event catering is the catering operation around that job: menu, chefs, service staff, equipment, setup and clearance. It is not AV, staging, venue hire or entertainment.

The best catering format for a corporate event in Dubai is the one the room can physically support. A floor with one service lift cannot run the same service as a dining room with a working kitchen. Once the job and the room are clear, headcount, dietary notes and budget follow.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Office catering ideas for team lunches and daily meetings
replace_in_block.new_heading: Office catering ideas for team lunches and daily meetings
new_paragraphs: Corporate lunch ideas in Dubai for a known team are usually drop-off: labelled boxes or platters, laid out, your people serve themselves. That is the AED 90 floor, minimum 10 guests and AED 900. Recurring weeks are billed on the actual service days.

A small corporate event catering idea that still belongs on the office page is a staffed meeting buffet from AED 120 per person, minimum 20 guests. One-off parties are not office catering. They sit on corporate event catering.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Ideas for launches, activations and corporate parties
replace_in_block.new_heading: Ideas for launches, activations and corporate parties
new_paragraphs: Office party food ideas in Dubai that keep people standing are passed canapés, about 8 to 12 pieces per guest over 90 minutes, from AED 150 per person. Nothing that needs a knife. The team can pause for a speech or a reveal.

Event catering ideas for a launch or brand moment use the same canapé floor. Food supports the product. It does not sit on laptops. Alcohol is only where the venue is licensed and it is agreed in writing.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Client dinners, galas and company events
replace_in_block.new_heading: Client dinners, galas and company events
new_paragraphs: A table of 10 to 15 is the corporate dinner package: AED 4,500 for the event, not multiplied by headcount, with chef and service staff sized to that table. Outside that range, chef-led plated dining is AED 700 to 950 per person.

A seated gala is a different clock: courses timed to speeches, staffed buffet or plated service, wine only where the licence allows it. Do not treat a 200-person banquet as if it were the 10 to 15 package.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Corporate catering menu ideas: what to put on the table
replace_in_block.new_heading: Event catering menu ideas that survive a mixed room
new_paragraphs: Event catering menu ideas that work in Dubai assume a mixed room. Halal ingredients are the default. Vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free dishes are planned when named in the brief. This is not a medical or allergen-free promise.

A working lunch wants one labelled main, a salad and fruit. A reception wants bites that finish in two mouthfuls. A seated dinner wants courses that can pause. Build the menu around the format, not around a cuisine list.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: How much does corporate catering cost in Dubai?
replace_in_block.new_heading: How much these ideas usually cost
new_paragraphs: Advertised floors: drop-off from AED 90 per person, staffed buffet from AED 120, canapés and live stations from AED 150, chef-led plated from AED 700 to 950 per person. The AED 4,500 corporate dinner package is a whole-event price for 10 to 15 guests.

Volume drop-off starts at 10 guests. A buffet starts at 20. Minimum order on drop-off is AED 900. 5% VAT is a separate line. Unusual venue access is quoted separately. A quote that hides staff, delivery or equipment is not cheaper. It is less complete.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Choosing a corporate catering company and getting logistics right
replace_in_block.new_heading: What to lock before you brief
new_paragraphs: Send occasion, date, area, guest count, drop-off or staffed service, meals or breaks, and a budget position if you have one. You do not need a full dietary list to start.

Ask how chefs are checked. myCHEF vets identity, right-to-work, cooking and references before anyone cooks for a client. No chef is guaranteed by name. Food businesses in Dubai sit under Dubai Municipality food-safety rules. Confirm current requirements before you book.
A written account for regular bookings is a separate page. Fees, credit, expiry and overages are set only in that agreement. An LPO does not create credit terms by itself.

Office weeks: office catering. Boardroom and client lunches: business lunch catering. Conferences: conference catering. Company parties: corporate event catering. The 10 to 15 dinner: corporate dinner package. Galas, launches, exhibitions and crew meals have their own pages. The checklist is the operational list. Full service versus drop-off is the coverage comparison.
Drop-off working lunch. Team meetings. About 45 minutes. From AED 90 per person. Food and delivery. You clear.
Staffed buffet. Department sitting or staff party. About an hour. From AED 120 per person. Food, staff, setup and clearance. Minimum 20 guests.
Canapé reception. Launch or networking. About 90 minutes. From AED 150 per person. Passed food, staff, setup and clearance.
Plated dinner. Client or executive table. Courses at the table. AED 700 to 950 per person, or AED 4,500 as a package for 10 to 15 guests.

Prices are advertised myCHEF floors from the catering price record: drop-off AED 90, buffet AED 120, canapés AED 150, plated AED 700 to 950, corporate dinner package AED 4,500 for 10 to 15 guests. VAT 5% on catering has applied in the UAE since 1 January 2018. Food safety sits with Dubai Municipality. Confirm current rules before you book.
What are good corporate event catering ideas in Dubai?
Match the format to the day. Drop-off lunch for a known team. Canapés for a standing party. Plated service for a seated client dinner. Link the idea to the owner page before you brief.
How much does corporate catering cost in Dubai?
Drop-off from AED 90 per person, buffet from AED 120, canapés from AED 150, plated AED 700 to 950. The 10 to 15 guest dinner package is AED 4,500 for the event.
What is event catering?
The food and hospitality operation around an agenda: menus, chefs, service staff, equipment, setup and clearance. Not AV, staging or venue hire.
How far ahead should we book?
A few days is usually enough for a repeating drop-off. Two to four weeks is comfortable for a staffed event. Earlier between November and March. The headcount deadline is confirmed in the proposal.
